title: The Unseen Record: Ninth–Seventh Millennia Cal. BP Wooden and Basketry Objects from Submerged Settlements off the Carmel Coast, Israel
version: Forests 14(12), 2373. Publisher HTML and published PDF, DOI 10.3390/f14122373.
lineage: Technical description of KS 2, reusing images of the 1994 fragments published by the excavation team in 2007. The proposed oil-processing use refers to Galili et al. (1997), a coauthored earlier excavation study.

passages.note: Three fragments of a twig basket, possibly from the base and walls, exhibit alternate pair-twining and were recovered alongside olive pits and wood fragments in a clay-filled pit at Kfar Samir. The authors propose a possible aqal-like oil-processing use.
passages.quote: The vessel was braided by the alternate pair-twining method.

passages.note: The authors give the site chronology with outer bounds of 7964–6299 cal BP. Table 1 does not use the direct braiding date published in the 2007 field report.
